question: Do graph features, and especially the added P123 profiles, discriminate generator families after exact matching on node count, relation count and height?
history: PR40 negative pilot motivated this design. All data in this study use a new namespace. This is a prospectively fixed conditional synthetic comparison, not blinded validation or an external replication.

matching.strata: Within each size/split/control, group each family by exact (R,H). Pair the kth draw (ascending draw number) in each stratum, without replacement within that comparison. Sort all eligible pairs by SHA256 of [namespace,pair-priority,control,n,split,reference_id,control_id], then take a fixed cap. Features, coordinate values and relation hashes do not participate in selection.
matching.acceptance: A comparison is EVALUABLE only when both independent split pools provide the full fixed caps. Otherwise record INSUFFICIENT_COMMON_SUPPORT and all available pairs but compute no performance claims for that cell. No relaxed calipers, relabelling of controls or replacement sampling.
matching.estimand: Performance on the selected common-support finite conditional distribution. Not the original generator population, not a causal effect, not manifoldlikeness. Reference observations may be reused across different descriptive control comparisons; they never cross train/test within a comparison.
matching.ledger: Every candidate id, draw, RNG split key, R, H and full-relation SHA256 is retained. Full coordinates, relations and features are retained for all observations selected in EVALUABLE comparisons. Every rejected/unselected draw can be regenerated from frozen source and ledger.

features.D: Only [R/choose(N,2),H/N]. This confound-only negative control must have identical within-class training/test distributions and balanced accuracy exactly 0.5 under the fixed centroid rule.
features.B: Unchanged PR40 link-degree distributions, strict interior interval histogram and sorted Hasse Laplacian eigenvalues with the same normalizations.
features.P123: Unchanged PR40 all-node pooled strict past/future intersection histograms through order three.
features.classifier: Unchanged training-only z-score nearest class centroid; std<=1e-12 uses scale 1; tie order minkowski then control. No hyperparameter tuning. R2+Pall/H7/N1/Q1 not evaluated.

analysis.primary_endpoint: Balanced accuracy gain B+P123 minus B on 128 test pairs. Bootstrap 2000 whole pairs with replacement, keeping the two members together; percentile 95% interval, linear quantiles; training set held fixed.
analysis.incremental_success: Primary cell EVALUABLE, gain >=0.05 and lower 95% paired bootstrap bound >0. Otherwise NO_DEMONSTRATED_INCREMENT, or INSUFFICIENT_COMMON_SUPPORT if not evaluable.
analysis.secondary: All other cells and models descriptive. For each model report confusion, per-observation predictions, whole-pair bootstrap 95% accuracy interval and the exact one-sided within-pair label-swap tail for accuracy above chance. The latter is binomial on pairs with opposite predicted labels; identical predicted labels contribute a fixed one correct. No multiple-testing-adjusted secondary discovery claims.
analysis.uncertainty: Conditional on fixed selected pools and training. Does not capture pool selection, matching, retraining, other generators or other N. Within-pair permutation assumes exchangeability under the conditional null; no causal interpretation.
analysis.diagnostics: Eligible/matched/unused counts and every stratum; all selected pair keys equal exactly; no duplicate id inside a cell or across its splits; coordinate-derived vs direct relation/height/interval checks; per-observation relabel invariance; separate scalar classifier; complete coverage. No post-result tuning.

selftests: Toy generator N=4 only and artificial ledgers; exact matching support gates; synthetic train/test and negative controls; no target pool creation before public freeze.
publication: Public contract then source freeze before candidate generation. Failures preserved; frozen sources never silently repaired after results. Entire old studies remain unchanged.
limitations: Fixed N is a conditioned sprinkling approximation with finite precision.
Exact matching can select a narrow atypical subpopulation; discarded observations are explicit.
No common support is not evidence that a geometric observable works.
Finite conditional discrimination does not establish geometry reconstruction, Lorentz invariance or continuum physics.
